prompt: A pale blue-robed human wizard with frost-rimed hair stands in left profile on a snow-covered battlefield, one hand thrust forward exhaling a cone of pale cyan frost across the scene. On the right, a hulking brown-furred ogre raises a heavy iron club to swing, but its swinging arm is sheathed in thick blue ice, frozen mid-strike, its power sapped, the club drooping. Snow and frost-fog fill the air. The background is a grey winter sky over a frozen field with bare black trees.

Close-up side profile of a snarling green-scaled lizard warrior, its muscular sword-arm encased in a thick block of jagged blue ice, the muscles withering and shrinking inside the frost, its longsword slipping from frozen fingers. Pale cyan magical cold radiates over its arm. The lizard grimaces in pain and weakness. The background is a dim frost-covered stone arena dusted with snow.

A brutish bare-chested orc warrior on the right kneels and buckles, his huge raised club-arm completely encased in a heavy block of pale blue ice, the frozen arm sagging downward, useless and weak, frost crackling over his shoulder. A slender blue-robed wizards hand intrudes from the left edge of the frame, fingers splayed, streaming cyan cold magic onto the orc. The orc grimaces, defeated and drained. The background is a dim snowy battlefield under a pale grey sky.

A young human wizard in a deep sapphire-blue hooded robe stands centered facing the viewer, both hands raised and cupped together conjuring a swirling orb of pale cyan frost, breath misting in the cold, icicles forming on his sleeves. A creeping sheet of blue rime-frost spreads outward across the stone floor away from him. The only light is the cold blue glow of his frost magic. The background is a shadowed stone wizards tower interior with frosted-over windows.

Tight close-up of a burly warriors muscular sword-arm seized and frozen solid inside a jagged block of pale blue ice, the muscles visibly shrinking and withering within the frost, his iron sword slipping from stiff frozen fingers. The warriors face at the top edge winces in pain. Thin cyan tendrils of cold magic wrap the frozen arm. The only light is the pale blue glow of the ice. The background is a dim snowy field.

A frost wizard in icy-white and cerulean robes with a long frost-white beard stands at the left, leaning forward and exhaling a long billowing breath of freezing cyan mist across the scene. On the right an armored enemy knight recoils, raising a shield that is icing over, frost spreading across his steel plate, his sword-arm going limp and slow. The background is a blizzard-swept mountain pass under heavy grey snow clouds.

A snarling enemy minotaur on the right side of the frame, its huge battle-axe arm frozen rigid inside a thick crust of pale blue ice, frost climbing up its shoulder and over its horns, the beast hunched and weakened, slowing to a stop. On the left a blue-cloaked wizard with raised open palm pours a wide stream of cyan freezing magic across the gap. The background is a snow-blanketed ruined courtyard with cracked icy flagstones under a pale winter sky.

A blue-robed human wizard with frost-white hair stands on the left in three-quarter view, calmly pressing one bare palm against the chest of a towering brown ogre, where the touch erupts into a spreading bloom of pale blue ice that races across the ogres torso and down its arms, freezing the ogre stiff and draining its strength as it sags. Frost-fog drifts between them. The background is a moonlit snowy field with bare trees.

A blue-robed human wizard with frost-rimed white hair stands in left profile, one hand thrust forward firing a wide cone of pale cyan frost. On the right a hulking enemy brute swings a heavy club, but his entire raised swinging arm is sheathed in thick jagged blue ice, frozen mid-strike, the club drooping, his power sapped away. Frost-fog and snowflakes fill the air between them. The background is a pale grey-blue winter battlefield with snow drifts and bare black trees.

Low dramatic angle looking up at a towering enemy warlord on the right whose massive weapon-arm is locked solid in a great block of pale blue ice, frost spidering across his armor as he buckles to one knee, strength draining out of him. In the lower left a small blue-cloaked wizard with frost-white hair lifts an open palm streaming cyan cold magic up at him. The only light is the cold blue glow of the frost. The background is a snowy ruined keep at dusk under a dark teal sky.
